rows.grounds: tat + ardha; half of the previously stated measure
tri + pāda; three parts out of four of that measure
tat + sama; equal to that previously stated measure

items.question: What alternative heights are prescribed relative to the previously specified measure?
premises: A height is being prescribed in relation to a previously stated measure.
One prescribed option is half of that measure.
Other prescribed options are three-quarters of that measure or equal to it.
items.inference: The prescribed height may be half, three-quarters, or equal to the previously specified measure.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the prior measure depends on the preceding verses.
items.plain_english: The height should be half of that, or three-quarters, or else equal to it.
